title: Find a customer's unpaid invoice
description: Shows how to open your invoices and search for a customer to check whether their invoice is still due.
answersQuestions: How do I check if a customer has paid?
Where can I see unpaid invoices?
How do I search for an invoice?

scenes.narration: Open Billing from the menu, then select the Invoices tab.
Type the customer's name in the search box. Invoices marked Due have not been paid yet.
